def _output_to_cpu(output):
    """Move model output to CPU, handling both single tensors and tuples."""
    if isinstance(output, (tuple, list)):
        return tuple(t.cpu() if torch.is_tensor(t) else t for t in output)
    return output.cpu()


def validate_correctness(ref_model, opt_model, inputs, device='cuda'):
    """
    Validate numerical correctness (supports single tensor and tuple outputs).

    Returns:
        (is_correct, max_diff, error_message)
    """
    ref_model = ref_model.to(device).eval()
    opt_model = opt_model.to(device).eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        torch.manual_seed(WEIGHT_INIT_SEED)
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.manual_seed(WEIGHT_INIT_SEED)

        ref_output = ref_model(*inputs)
        if device == "cuda":

            torch.cuda.synchronize()
        ref_output_cpu = _output_to_cpu(ref_output)
        del ref_output

        torch.manual_seed(WEIGHT_INIT_SEED)
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.manual_seed(WEIGHT_INIT_SEED)

        opt_output = opt_model(*inputs)
        if device == "cuda":
            BenchmarkWrapper._probe_cuda_output(opt_output)
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
        opt_output_cpu = _output_to_cpu(opt_output)
        del opt_output
        if device == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    del inputs
    if device == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    # Normalize to tuples for uniform handling
    if isinstance(ref_output_cpu, (tuple, list)):
        ref_outputs = tuple(ref_output_cpu)
    else:
        ref_outputs = (ref_output_cpu,)

    if isinstance(opt_output_cpu, (tuple, list)):
        opt_outputs = tuple(opt_output_cpu)
    else:
        opt_outputs = (opt_output_cpu,)

    if len(ref_outputs) != len(opt_outputs):
        return False, None, f"Output count mismatch: opt returns {len(opt_outputs)} vs ref {len(ref_outputs)}"

    overall_max_diff = 0.0
    for i, (ref, opt) in enumerate(zip(ref_outputs, opt_outputs)):
        if not torch.is_tensor(ref) or not torch.is_tensor(opt):
            continue

        prefix = f"[output {i}] " if len(ref_outputs) > 1 else ""

        if ref.shape != opt.shape:
            return False, None, f"{prefix}Shape mismatch: {opt.shape} vs {ref.shape}"

        abs_diff = torch.abs(ref - opt)
        max_diff = torch.max(abs_diff).item()
        overall_max_diff = max(overall_max_diff, max_diff)

        if not torch.allclose(ref, opt, rtol=RTOL, atol=ATOL):
            max_idx = torch.argmax(abs_diff)
            ref_val = ref.flatten()[max_idx].item()
            opt_val = opt.flatten()[max_idx].item()
            error_msg = (

                f"(ref={ref_val:.6e}, opt={opt_val:.6e}, "
                f"rtol={RTOL:.2e}, atol={ATOL:.2e})"
            )
            return False, max_diff, error_msg

    return True, overall_max_diff, None

    for _ in range(NUM_TRIALS):
        with torch.no_grad():
            _ = model(*inputs)

    torch.cuda.synchronize()
